meta.description:

In this episode, visited the night food market in Phu Quoc and had a fabulous time there tasting all local foods. 
Do watch the video fully to know the famous street food varities availabe there.

comments.author: @gotripAI-com
comments.text:
Watched the full video and Phu Quoc - it looks incredible! For anyone planning a trip there, here are the absolute must-see highlights from this vlog:

00:00:10 - That seafood spread is next level. Freshness is 10/10 there.
00:06:00 - Pro Tip: Most of these stalls are cash-only, so hit the ATM before you enter!
00:16:09 - The Vietnamese Pizza (Bánh Tráng Nướng) is a must-try street snack.
00:24:31 - Don't skip the rolled ice cream—it's as much a performance as it is a dessert.

Quick heads up for travelers: PQC airport is very strict about not allowing Fish Sauce (Nước Mắm) in carry-on, so pack it in your checked bag or buy it at the duty-free! Safe travels everyone.
